tree_state: the files listed under sha256 are uncommitted at recording time and are committed in the commit that follows this record; the recorded commit is its parent
summary: The image loader-diag-xnu-md0-usb: NAT-062's loader image family with a different XNU payload (a 16635-byte probe-init ramdisk behind rd=md0, a /chosen/memory-map RAMDisk property, the command line plus launchdsuffix=release cs_enforcement_disable=1), its driver and analyser (root reading), 24 + 52 host tests, 56/58 mutants killed (2 equivalent), decision 0027 drafted. Nothing ran on the phone.
evidence_category: host-test (derivation, static reads of the real payload, the loader's real adt_patch.c built for the host with a C harness under ASAN/UBSAN, a unicorn simulation of the probe init with a fake syscall table, the NAT-062 driver/analyser against simulated archives, derived NAT-062 suites). No android-userland and no native-device evidence; unicorn is not an Exynos model or XNU.

acceptance.1_build: build.py re-derives NAT-062's loader image and rebuilds the payload with the pinned mkpayload.py --ramdisk from the pinned NAT-020 inputs and the probe init; two builds (build-001, build-002) give identical hashes and test_nat065.py rebuilds the payload and the probe byte for byte; every input is pinned by SHA-256 (build.json nat065_pins); the NAT-062 command-line patch and the NAT-022 adt_size fix are not used.
acceptance.2_tests: test_nat065.py (24 tests: Inputs, Build, Rebuild, Payload, Loader, Ramdisk, Package) and test_nat065_run.py (52 tests: own Derivation, Root, RootThroughTheAnalyser plus NAT-062's Flow, RealTreeGate and Verdicts derived by asserted text substitution): the payload differs from NAT-062's only by the segment, the property and the header fields NAT-064 lists; the loader rebase (real adt_patch.c) puts the RAMDisk range in the kernel window outside every other segment; the ramdisk is a valid static arm64 Mach-O with correct page hashes and its simulated run exits 81/96/82; the driver and analyser accept the new image name; root classification covers all outcomes.
acceptance.3_mutants: mutants.py: 58 mutants (build, probe, analyser, driver, derivation); 56 killed, 2 equivalent (M12, M13, reasons in mutants.py), none survived, none invalid; controls without mutation pass.
acceptance.4_decision_draft: decision-draft.md names both hashes (RECOVERY c6f4a6e4..., Image.payload 60ca7fc9...), decision 0019, what the kernel may now touch (mount a RAM image, exec a user-mode program, scheduler and syscalls, unbounded reach), the 83 s watchdog and deadline budget, the untested timed return, the 5 s mount-retry loop with no panic; it records no run-specific owner confirmation and nothing ran on the phone.

established: Host-test: the payload, ADT property and ramdisk are built reproducibly and match the structure NAT-064 designed (segment at the old kernel_end, RAMDisk property of 52 bytes, ADT 14008 bytes, header fields).

Host-test: the loader's real ADT code rebases the RAMDisk property by win_base - phys_base, leaves other properties alone and refuses malformed trees; the resulting range is inside the kernel window and outside every other segment.
Host-test: the probe init makes only open/write/getpid/select/exit calls, keeps SP 16-aligned at every svc and exits 0x50+pid (0x60 without a console) in a unicorn run with a fake syscall table.

Host-test: the analyser separates probe-ran-to-exit, probe-no-console, init-exited-other, init-killed, root-device-missing (the real NAT-063 kernel log), other-panic and no-panic-text, and degrades to undetermined/no-panic-text on NAT-063's foreign archive.
not_established: Anything about the real phone: whether the ramdisk bytes land where ml_static_ptovirt expects them (the loader rebase has never run on hardware), whether vfs_mountroot accepts the raw Mach-O through the mockfs, whether exec of an ad-hoc-signed init is permitted, whether PID 1's console text reaches loader_log live.
That the timed loader_return_after=8 return works (NAT-063 returned through the panic path) or that a failed mount ends other than by the timed return or the deadline reset.
That a probe exit status of 81 appears in the panic text on the phone; the analyser's reading is of text that the simulated archives and one real log (NAT-063) exercise, not of a PID 1 run.
findings: With the RAMDisk property the ADT is 14008 bytes, already a multiple of 8, so NAT-022's adt_size fix (13956 -> 13960) must not be applied; build.py refuses it.
A derived test suite must set the derived classes' __module__ to the module that carries the fixtures, or unittest runs tearDownModule when it switches module mid-suite and 28 tests error.

Derived texts are checked by asserted substitution counts (including the 3 legitimate NAT-062 mentions left in the registry tuples), so a drifted NAT-062 file fails loudly instead of silently testing the wrong thing.
The re-targeted Verdicts layer takes minutes and is not re-run per mutant; it runs in the full run test.
